basis: October 28, 2024 is the earliest qualifying communication I could verify. Douglas Dynamics reported consolidated GAAP net sales of $129,398,000 for the three months ended September 30, 2024, down 10.22% from $144,121,000 a year earlier and below the $136,914,950 threshold. The earliest date remains unresolved because a historical index lists a September 20 investor presentation whose contents I could not verify.

coverage.detail: The April 29 Q1 release updated the full-year 2024 outlook after the snow season and early preseason orders. It gave no upper bound for consolidated Q3 sales.

The July 29 Q2 release maintained full-year net sales guidance of $600 million to $640 million. Subtracting first-half sales of $295.557 million implies $304.443 million to $344.443 million for Q3 and Q4 combined. The approximate 65/35 Q2/Q3 split applied only to Attachments preseason shipments and did not bound consolidated Q3 revenue.

The issuer calendar dates the Q1 and Q2 calls to April 30 and July 30. On the July call, management reiterated the annual sales range and discussed the preseason shipment split and Q3 adjusted EBITDA margins. Those remarks supplied no consolidated Q3 sales ceiling.

The September 11 announcement disclosed a $64.2 million sale-leaseback of operating facilities. The company leased the facilities back, preserving the operating-business perimeter. The Q3 income statement recorded the transaction gain separately from net sales.
The September 17 release announced management changes and supplied no Q3 consolidated sales forecast.

This secondary index lists investor slides dated May 8 and September 20, 2024. I could verify the listings but could not read issuer copies of either deck to rule out earlier quarter-specific guidance.
The October 15 notice scheduled results for after market close on October 28 and the call for October 29. It supplied no preliminary sales figure.

The October 28 release gives the exact comparative figures in its Consolidated Statements of Income. The three-month net sales row reads 129,398 for 2024 and 144,121 for 2023, in thousands of dollars.

publication_date_evidence: The issuer’s Q3 results release and SEC Exhibit 99.1 both carry the October 28, 2024 dateline, consistent with the issuer’s October 15 scheduling notice. October 29 was the call and filing date. The dollar value above is the verified October 28 actual.
